name: Munich Airport

runway.v: two runways, each 4 km long and 60 m wide
runway.quote: 2 runways each 4 km long and 60 m wide

curfew.v: core night period from midnight to 05:00, when only mail flights and DFS survey flights are automatically permitted; other exceptions are emergencies, safety landings and individual flights approved by the authority; from 22:00 to midnight and 05:00 to 06:00 only aircraft on the Ministry of Transport bonus list may operate
curfew.quote: During the core period (from midnight until 0500 hours) only mail flights and surveying flights by German Air Traffic Control are automatically permitted.

noise.v: from 22:00 to midnight and 05:00 to 06:00 only aircraft on the Ministry of Transport bonus list may operate
noise.quote: only aircraft on the so-called Ministry of Transport bonus list are allowed to operate

slots.v: Level 3 coordinated airport; general aviation flights need a slot from the German airport coordinator (Fluko)
slots.quote: Coordination of General Aviation flights is required at the following Level 3 airports:

handling.v: General Aviation Terminal (GAT) run by Flughafen München GmbH; companies listed there include ExecuJet Europe GmbH, Signature Flight Support - SFS Munich GmbH & Co. KG, MAS Munich Aviation Service, AHS München Aviation Handling Services GmbH and Lufthansa Technik AG
handling.quote: there is no obligation to handle passengers and aircraft at the General Aviation Terminal!

notes: DFS AIP could not be read (robots block), so runway and location come from the operator's site; widths/lengths are as the operator states them (4 km). Coordinates not recorded because the AIP ARP could not be read (the operator's 2016 facts sheet gives 48°21'17" N, 11°47'15" E). Night rules: the bonus list also limits scheduled/charter night flights to max. 28 per night under an annual quota. GAT operating hours 06:00-22:00 (office 05:30-22:00) per the operator, but these are the terminal's hours, not the airport's.
